name: Locked WAVES sign zone
notes: The area around the locked WAVES sign (10 px on every side of it): while the monster is in it, 'spot' is 10 (the head label says WAVES) and 'near' is 2 (the bottom line says how many monster types are still to free, from 'unlocked': 8 MONSTER TYPES LEFT ... 1 MONSTER TYPE LEFT). A or B do nothing there. Gone once all 9 monsters are freed (appear_if).
